name: Paper Cutout
description: Scenes built from layered sheets of paper: flat coloured shapes with slightly irregular scissor-cut edges, each layer casting a small soft shadow onto the one beneath.
visual_characteristics: 3-7 clearly separated layers from back to front
flat matte colour per sheet (no gradients), occasional printed-paper pattern
small consistent drop shadow under each layer, creating physical depth
slightly wavy, hand-cut edges; simplified organic shapes

palette.guidance: Craft-paper palette: 5-8 flat colours, warm neutrals + 2-3 saturated accents. Depth via value: farther layers lighter/cooler, nearer layers darker/warmer, or vice versa consistently.

geometry: Organic simplified silhouettes with gently irregular outlines (avoid perfect circles); scissor-cut nicks and small straight-cut facets; punched circles for holes. Layers interlock.
stroke: None. Edges are the paper edge. Optional very thin lighter edge highlight on the top layer.
texture: Optional fine paper fibre via feTurbulence at ~6% opacity on a single overlay; or subtle speckle pattern. No gradients within a sheet.
composition: Landscape-like depth stacking (sky, far hills, mid hills, trees, foreground, subject). Subject contrast against the nearest background layer. Overlaps generous.
typography: Cut-out letter blocks with slight rotation and offset shadows, chunky sans or rounded shapes.
lighting_depth: Light from top-left: each layer gets a 2-4 unit soft shadow offset down-right (opacity .25-.35). Shadow grows slightly for higher layers.
svg_techniques: define ONE drop-shadow filter (feDropShadow dx=1.5 dy=2.5 stdDeviation=2 opacity .3) and apply it to each layer group
one <g id="layer-N"> per sheet in strict back-to-front order
irregular edges by hand-nudged path points or Q-curves with slight asymmetry
paper texture as a single <rect> overlay using feTurbulence + feColorMatrix at low opacity
avoid: more than one blur filter definition

name: Hand Drawn / Doodle
description: Loose, human line work: wobbly contours, uneven weights, offset colour fills that do not quite stay in the lines, and playful imperfection that feels drawn in a notebook.
visual_characteristics: lines that overshoot and wobble slightly; double-stroked contours in places
colour fills offset from the outlines (mis-registration) and scribble/hatch fills
simplified naive proportions with character
sparse small doodle fillers (stars, dots, squiggles, arrows)

palette.guidance: Marker/pen palette: black or dark-blue ink line, 3-5 highlighter-like fill colours at slight transparency, warm paper white or cream base.

geometry: Nothing perfectly straight or circular: hand-nudged control points, closed shapes that do not quite close, slightly rotated boxes. Keep proportion errors intentional and small.
stroke: Round caps and joins always; weight varies 2-5 units between paths (or use two overlapping strokes with slight offset). Ink line colour is dark, not pure black.
texture: Scribble hatching fills built from many short zig-zag strokes; optional faint paper grain. Fills offset by 2-4 units from outlines.
composition: Centred subject with loosely arranged doodle props; unequal spacing; a wobbly underline or frame; playful scale contrast.
typography: Handwritten look: build letters from wobbly strokes (or use a cursive/fantasy generic fallback and mention it). Keep short.
lighting_depth: None; maybe hatch shading on one side. Depth only by overlap.
svg_techniques: produce wobble by authoring paths with irregular quadratic curves (Q/T) and slightly uneven control points; optionally displace with ONE subtle feTurbulence+feDisplacementMap (scale 1.5-2.5) on the whole line group
fills as separate <path> layers under the line layer, translated by (2,1.5) to mimic mis-registration
hatching as a <pattern> of slightly rotated short lines used sparingly
stroke-linecap/linejoin round; vary stroke-width per path

name: Sticker
description: A bold, self-contained design wrapped by a thick white die-cut border and a subtle shadow, so it reads as an adhesive object regardless of the background.
visual_characteristics: thick uniform white outline (contour offset) around the whole silhouette
saturated, high-contrast colours; dark interior outlines
simple readable shapes, charming character focus
optional glossy highlight streak and a tiny peeled-corner

palette.guidance: Saturated 4-7 colour palette on flat fills with darker outlines; the white border is pure white (#fff); a soft neutral drop shadow beneath. Avoid muddy midtones.

geometry: Rounded, friendly, simplified shapes; die-cut contour smooth with no tiny notches (merge islands so the border is one continuous shape).
stroke: Interior outlines 3-4 units, round joins; the die-cut border = the merged silhouette path stroked 10-14 units white with round joins, drawn UNDER the art.
texture: None or subtle halftone on one shadow area; optional tiny sparkle marks.
composition: Single centred subject filling ~80% of the canvas; sticker slightly rotated (-3..-6 degrees) optional; transparent background so the border and shadow carry the object.
typography: Chunky rounded or brush caps with outline; text also gets the white border via the merged silhouette.
lighting_depth: Flat art with a soft shadow below-right; optional white curved gloss streak clipped to the subject at 25% opacity.
svg_techniques: duplicate the merged silhouette as <path id="cut"> in defs; <use> it first with fill=#fff stroke=#fff stroke-width=12 stroke-linejoin=round
one soft feDropShadow (or blurred offset copy) on the border layer only
artwork layers above the border with dark outlines
transparent background (no full-canvas rect)
avoid: filling the canvas with a background rect

name: Children's Illustration
description: Warm, friendly picture-book art: rounded characters with big expressive faces, soft painterly textures, cheerful palettes and simple storytelling compositions.
visual_characteristics: round, soft shapes; oversized heads and eyes; warm expressions
gouache/crayon-like flat colour with soft grain and visible imperfection
cheerful but not garish palette; cozy scenes with small narrative details
generous negative space for text

palette.guidance: Warm, slightly chalky mid-saturation colours: sunny yellow, tomato red, sky blue, leaf green, blush; cream paper base. Shadows are gentle tints, not greys.

geometry: Rounded, slightly asymmetrical shapes; circles for cheeks/bodies; short limbs; soft terminals. Small proportion exaggeration for charm.
stroke: Optional soft outline in a warm dark (brown/plum) with round caps at 2-3 units, slightly varied; or no outline with colour-on-colour details.
texture: Light crayon/gouache grain via one low-opacity feTurbulence overlay clipped to shapes; sparse dotted patterns on clothes and grass.
composition: Story-first: one clear focal character on a gentle vignette scene (hill, house, moon); leading path or curved horizon; open area for title.
typography: Rounded, hand-lettered feel; large friendly title; generous letter spacing.
lighting_depth: Soft glow around light sources (moon/lantern), gentle cast shadows as flat tinted ellipses; no hard specular.
svg_techniques: compose characters from <ellipse>/<circle> + soft Q-curve paths; reuse eyes, cheeks, paws through <use>
one grain filter (feTurbulence baseFrequency .8) applied to a single overlay rect masked by the artwork alpha
soft glows via radialGradient only
keep stroke colour warm-dark and consistent

name: Editorial Illustration
description: Concept-driven imagery: a single strong visual metaphor rendered with sophisticated shape language, restrained palette, textural flair and confident scale contrast.
visual_characteristics: one idea, one metaphor, instantly readable at thumbnail size
unexpected scale relationships and juxtapositions (giant hand / tiny figure)
limited palette of 3-5 sophisticated colours with one accent
flat shapes plus purposeful texture (grain, halftone, brush edge)

palette.guidance: Sophisticated, slightly desaturated 3-5 colours (deep teal, ochre, brick, ink, cream) plus one punchy accent; strong value structure; avoid rainbow palettes.

geometry: Bold simplified shapes with stylised proportions; strong diagonals; cropping that lets shapes bleed off the canvas; occasional cut-out/collage overlaps.
stroke: Sparingly; when used, expressive tapered lines (filled variable-width paths) rather than uniform strokes.
texture: Grain and halftone on shadows and large flat areas; subtle paper texture overlay; brush-edge irregularities on key shapes.
composition: Rule of thirds or dynamic asymmetry; deliberate negative space for headline; a clear hierarchy of 1 hero + 2 supporting shapes; cropping for drama.
typography: Rarely embedded; if included, editorial serif/grotesk pairing at small scale.
lighting_depth: Graphic light: flat shadow shapes and one gradient at most; depth via overlap and scale.
svg_techniques: layered flat shapes with mix of clip-paths to create collage-like overlaps
halftone via <pattern> of circles masked by a gradient (tone-dependent dot size)
grain overlay as feTurbulence rect at 8% multiply-like opacity (single filter)
tapered lines as closed paths

name: Organic / Botanical
description: Plants and natural forms rendered with graceful flowing curves, layered petals/leaves, delicate vein detail and harmonious natural palettes.
visual_characteristics: asymmetric, rhythmic growth patterns; stems curve in S-shapes
layered leaves/petals with overlapping tone changes
fine vein and stamen detail; occasional bud/seed/insect accents
natural palette with a single flower accent

palette.guidance: Greens with hue variation (yellow-green to blue-green), warm bloom accent (coral, ochre, lilac), cream or soft sage ground. Shade with darker green, never black.

geometry: Curves-first: Bezier stems, teardrop and lanceolate leaf shapes, radial petal arrays (built with rotated <use>). Slight variation in each repeated leaf (scale, rotate, hue) so nothing looks copy-pasted.
stroke: Fine 0.75-1.5 unit tapered veins/outlines in a dark green or sepia; round caps. For flat variants, fill-only with vein cut-outs.
texture: Subtle watercolour wash via 2-3 stacked low-opacity fills and gradient edges; speckle; optional paper tone.
composition: Curving diagonal growth (Hogarth curve) or symmetric wreath; specimens with generous margin; scientific-print layout with small captions optional; overlap for density at the base.
typography: Small italic serif captions (Latin-like names), letterspaced; optional.
lighting_depth: Soft: leaf undersides lighter, tone shifts at folds; light from one side with gradient shading on leaves.
svg_techniques: define one leaf symbol (shape + vein group) and <use> it with varied transform, then override fill via CSS variable or currentColor
petal rings by rotating one <use> in 5-8 steps around a centre
gradient shading per leaf (linearGradient along the midrib) defined once via gradientTransform variations
stems as stroked paths with stroke-linecap round; veins as thin child paths
